verdict.rationale: Dialpad is a messaging-capable communications platform, so automatic STOP/HELP handling and opt-out suppression is a fair question to ask of it. The pack has no evidence of either capability. The only related item is company-wide number blocking, which rejects inbound calls and texts. That is an adjacent control, not keyword handling or suppression of future outbound sends.

support.subject: As a support leader, STOP and HELP keywords are handled automatically and opted-out contacts are suppressed from future sends
